summary.en-US: Hide YouTube Shorts, the home feed, recommendations, comments and other distractions, each behind its own toggle

description.en-US:
Turns YouTube into a focused video player. Every feature is off by default, enable only what you need from the popup.

- Hide the homepage feed, optionally redirect to Subscriptions
- Hide Shorts on every page, or open them in the regular player
- Hide the video sidebar, comments, live chat and end screen cards
- Disable autoplay, separately for playlists and regular videos
- Hide search recommendations, Explore, Trending and More from YouTube
- Hide, blur or reveal-on-hover thumbnails
- One power button turns every rule off without a reload

No data collection, no network requests. Settings are stored in browser sync storage.

Source code: https://github.com/nnyj/youtube-declutter
